stories.headline: Electoral reform defeated as PT and PVEM break with Morena; Sheinbaum announces Plan B
stories.summary: President Sheinbaum's electoral reform failed in the Chamber of Deputies after allied parties PT and PVEM voted against it alongside opposition parties. The reform needed a qualified majority but only got 259 votes in favor versus 234 against. Sheinbaum announced a 'Plan B' constitutional reform package as alternative.

articles.title: Rechazan reforma electoral de Sheinbaum en Diputados; Morena anuncia Plan B

stories.headline: Trump-Sheinbaum clash over US military intervention proposals against cartels
stories.summary: President Trump criticized President Sheinbaum for rejecting US military assistance against Mexican cartels, posting on Truth Social that cartels control Mexico. Sheinbaum responded that Mexico maintains security cooperation with the US but national sovereignty is non-negotiable.

articles.title: Sheinbaum: no está bien informado; sí existe colaboración

stories.headline: García Harfuch gains popularity following El Mencho operation; spawns merchandise craze
stories.summary: Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch's popularity surged after revealing details of the operation that killed CJNG leader 'El Mencho.' His image now appears on blankets, dolls, and various merchandise sold in Mexican markets, with early polls showing him leading potential 2030 presidential candidates.

articles.title: Harfuch, disponible en muñecos, toallas y cobijas

stories.headline: Sheinbaum hosts Nordic business delegation seeking investment opportunities
stories.summary: President Sheinbaum received over 80 Nordic business executives at the National Palace, including representatives from ABB, Ericsson, Maersk, Nokia, and Volvo. The delegation expressed interest in investing in Mexico, with meetings also held with various federal officials over several days.

articles.title: Sheinbaum recibe a delegación empresarial nórdica
Se reúne Sheinbaum con empresarios nórdicos

stories.headline: Government reveals millionaire pensions in state enterprises; some exceed presidential salary
stories.summary: The Anticorruption Secretariat published a list of 98,055 people receiving pensions from state entities including Pemex, CFE, and development banks. Some ex-officials receive over 1 million pesos monthly, with the highest being Carlos Arturo Sánchez Magaña from Pemex at 1.1 million pesos.

articles.title: Gobierno de Sheinbaum exhibe pensiones en Pemex, CFE y bancos estatales
Se jubilaron de Pemex y Luz y Fuerza, ahora cobran pensiones de hasta un millón de pesos al mes

stories.headline: Pemex contractor's lavish XV años party with Belinda and J Balvin sparks corruption concerns
stories.summary: Juan Carlos Guerrero Rojas, a Pemex contractor with over 4 billion pesos in contracts, organized an extravagant quinceañera party featuring celebrities Belinda and J Balvin. The estimated 45 million peso celebration highlighted wealth disparities and raised questions about contractor relationships with the state oil company.

articles.title: Empresario de la fiesta de XV años tiene al menos dos contratos con PEMEX por más de 4 mil mdp
Contratista de Pemex está detrás de lujosa fiesta de XV años amenizada por Belinda y J. Balvin

stories.headline: Oil spill affects Veracruz and Tabasco coasts; government coordinates cleanup response
stories.summary: Hydrocarbon residues appeared on beaches in southern Veracruz and parts of Tabasco. Federal government coordinates cleanup efforts through Semar, Pemex, and Semarnat. Governor Nahle reported the spill originated from a private vessel near Sánchez Magallanes, not Pemex operations.

articles.title: Gobierno federal coordina acciones por presencia de hidrocarburos en playas de Tabasco y Veracruz
¡No fue Pemex! Rocío Nahle revela quién causó el derrame en costas de Veracruz

stories.headline: Sheinbaum confirms likely Brazil visit before June following Lula invitation
stories.summary: President Sheinbaum said it's 'very probable' she will visit Brazil before June 2026, responding to multiple invitations from President Lula da Silva. She indicated the visit would occur before Brazil's electoral campaign period begins.

articles.title: Es muy probable que Sheinbaum viaje a Brasil antes de junio
La presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum dijo que es probable que viaje a Brasil
